code_native_art.source: All sixteen levels use the approved painted family. Native drawing remains for state-driven wings/legs/faces, arrows, warning fields, readable text, timer arcs and transient particles; former whole-object vector render paths are removed.
code_native_art.collision_contract: Model, coordinates and rules unchanged. Solids keep opaque coverage of full authored rectangles; player collision radius stays14 (9 while charging). No new collision is inferred from art, soft fringes or background. Shelter safe rectangle is p±half_width and y[-64,+76]; crown bottom <=p.y-65. Goal aperture and ring direction remain model-authoritative.
code_native_art.frame: Godot 4.6.2, Compatibility, Apple M1 Pro; 1280x800 native and 960x600 sample checked.
code_native_art.background_selection: Select by chapter.region, not theme. Theme/storm supply light and weather; backgrounds have no hard foreground promises in the flight corridor.
code_native_art.animation_contract: Real model flags/timers and presentation clock drive states. Pause freezes presentation; new stage, title, continue and recovery clear transients. Restored consumed/open/broken states do not replay their events.
code_native_art.implementation_status: All sixteen levels integrated and native screenshots checked; full source and exported-pack routes passed.

ui.source: Project Godot drawing and controls in main.gd; operating-system Chinese font fallback
ui.stamina: Five 20-point segments, numeric current stamina, pending burst cost highlight and delayed loss trail
ui.clock: Elapsed journey in ordinary levels; exposed-time budget and spatial chase in storm levels. Both stop at earned arrival.
ui.handoff: 2.4-second earned landing; region boundaries 4.5 seconds with season text. Enter skips, pause/focus loss freezes. Stage 04 continues into summer; only stage 16 ends the full journey.
ui.progress: 16 levels / 60 encounters / 38 shared safe leaves / 15 dew. Standard journey v2 still uses version6/content_revision8. Full art entry uses before_the_rain_art_full_20261023.json; dedicated05 entry is separate. Title selection restarts the current entry journey. Final path-isolation/continuation evidence must be read from the current receipt.
ui.local_feedback: Actual wind contact has directional pushing feedback including charge; approach is explicitly not contact. Shelter and fresh/recovery state preserve safety. Fountain phase and material feedback retained.
ui.sample_revision: Light objective/stamina cards, measured cue/toast widths, small context-dependent footer, high-flight charge prompt below the bee. Five stamina segments and visible numeric drain remain.
ui.art_revision: 0.9.0 extends the compact warm wood/cream/gold family to all sixteen levels. Preserve five stamina segments, numeric drain, actual context cues, state timings and no duplicate generic charge/rest prompt. Native source and packaged 1280x800 / 960x600 layout evidence recorded in the rollout receipt.

style_references.use: Broad garden-cartoon visual reference only; no characters, sprites, logos or screenshots are shipped.
Official soundtrack context for light, playful garden mood; no audio download, transcription or melody reuse.

audio.source: Original deterministic PCM synthesis authored in project code. No external samples, recordings or transcriptions.
audio.arrangements: Three original eight-bar / 32-beat A/B arrangements, 64 eighth-note slots. Offbeat plucks, toy keys/wooden mallets, alternating bass root/fifth, light percussion. Third act shifts to minor harmony and denser pulse.
audio.mix: Fixed synthesis gain 1.45; 1.2s stage music crossfade, 4dB event duck, retained mute and fixed 8-voice SFX pool.
audio.verification_output: SWARM_AUDIO_DIR or OS cache directory/before-the-rain-audio-qa; three WAVs and signal-report.json. PCM checks are technical evidence, not human listening acceptance.

applicability_convention: Level numbers are one-based. Shared means reused across the game; it does not assert that each object occurs in every level. Regional identifies a place-specific family; exclusive identifies authored chapter-end or dialogue use. Object-level mappings below are authoritative.

sample_sets.format: Level 01: historical code-native 0.8.0 set. Level 05: 0.8.1 independent sprite family and scenery plate with native state-driven presentation.
sample_sets.frame: 1280x800 keep-aspect; 960x600 native-window capture; Compatibility renderer. Filled shapes use same-color line AA, no unsupported 2D MSAA.
sample_sets.planes: sky / unoutlined low-contrast distant set / exact model-backed interaction silhouettes / bottom foliage
sample_sets.states: Existing charge, launch, rescue, leaf rest and goal landing retained and checked in actual input routes; additional wing veins and Xiaoman periodic local greeting. Presentation clock freezes on pause.
sample_sets.repeat_rule: Preserve model anchors and directions. Each hedge partition sits in an opaque sprite core with a forgiving 35-pixel foliage fringe outside its unchanged collider; broad beds use overlapping full clusters, not clipped or flattened tiles. Canopy underside remains above the safe pocket. Background bounded shift avoids a wrap seam. Do not bulk-expand other levels before the art direction decision.
sample_sets.status: 0.8.0 art rejected by Alan; 0.8.1 stage-05 target pending visual review

historical_validation.engine: Godot 4.6.2 stable, OpenGL Compatibility on Apple M1 Pro
historical_validation.result: 0.7.1: 1533 model checks, 60 per-level route checks, 449 native full UI/capture checks; final wind visual slice 30 checks. Ordinary key reproduction bypasses wind flowers: release 1s = -159.99px, charge 0.5s = -80px, zero bursts/recoveries. 54 old 0.7.0 checkpoint fixtures and actual save copy restore; no user save writes. Developer evidence only.
historical_validation.rhythm_revision: 0.3.1 retains the original art and all music. Native input-route captures and technical checks recorded in the local rhythm-feedback delivery receipt; player feel acceptance remains pending.
historical_validation.chapter_revision: 0.4.0 keeps all three original music arrangements unchanged; known-answer developer route is roughly 5-6 minutes, not evidence for the initial 20-30-minute first-play target.
historical_validation.chase_revision: 0.4.1 retains map geometry, entity counts, control physics, stamina rewards and original music; authored section storm pace and clearer relay/chase feedback. Near-rain capture is an explicit UI state fixture, not a player run.
historical_validation.living_revision: 0.4.2 retains all map, model, input, save and audio source. Revises silhouettes, action poses and bounded plant reactions. Real v2 progress is checked from an isolated copy, never overwritten by QA.
historical_validation.rescue_revision: Existing geometry, resources, player collision, rain and music retained. Native ordinary-key rescue tests cover temporary departures, pause, active player control, expiry, recovery and restart; save continuation never replays rescue effects.
historical_validation.facing_revision: 0.4.4 fixes left-facing body inversion using horizontal mirroring plus pitch; resting bodies settle level. Model, input, saves and sound unchanged. Native directional/charge/dash/rest captures and checks recorded in the upright-flight delivery receipt.
historical_validation.chapter05_revision: Five authored encounters per stage, three broad saves per stage, 20 optional dew, rescue distribution 4/2/1/1. Direct, all-dew and no-shield ordinary-input paths complete. Shield-turn fixture uses no dash and finishes before expiry; elapsed time is a known-answer route measurement, not first-play time.
historical_validation.pacing_revision: Dew authored as ordered optional beats, rescue refill carries into subsequent flight, nine deliberate shelters, six dew with dynamic save/UI counts. Weather follows encounter purpose. Direct/all-dew/no-shield/flow-through complete without recovery; recovery test uses five explicit returns after rescues. Flow-through rain route reaches 2.07 stamina, not novice-tolerance proof.
historical_validation.arrival_revision: Level 02 supply precedes the route split. Crossing the goal aperture completes before same-substep weather damage; model/time/stamina freeze throughout presentation. All music generation functions remain byte-identical to 0.5.1; only arrival bell synthesis added.
historical_validation.full_alpha_revision: Twelve authored levels added; twenty-four per-level routes passed. Whole known-answer routes ~5m40s/~6m16s, not evidence for the unvalidated 2–3-hour first-play target. Original movement and sound.gd unchanged.
historical_validation.season_routes_revision: 05–15 reauthored with 38 real terrain areas, 5 phased fountains, 6 local airflows. Twenty-four per-level routes complete with no terrain hits, fountain damage or recovery. Whole known-answer routes ~6m28s/~6m39s; not first-player timing. Spring definition and sound.gd remain byte-identical to 0.6.0. UI fixture captures are separate from continuous-input route captures.
historical_validation.interaction_coherence_revision: Continuous local wind for idle/charge; dash resistance retained following explicit user clarification. All six authored airflow regions exercise state combinations, actual-key UI reproduction avoids wind flowers. Two updraft bounds clear solid terrain; existing progress layout and sound.gd unchanged.
historical_validation.sample_revision: 0.8.0: 1577 model checks, 530 native complete UI/capture checks (two complete sixteen-level input routes), 140-rule airflow baseline and two old defects rejected by 12/6 behavior assertions. 12 targeted 05/actual-0.7.1-save continuation routes, all without collision/damage/recovery. Native 1280x800 plus 960x600 sample capture. Developer evidence only; no new player acceptance.
historical_validation.art_revision: 0.8.1: 1577 rules, 538 native full UI checks and 89 focused sample checks; ordinary-input upper/lower routes plus 1280x800 and 960x600 captures. Final-leaf exit text regression checked. Developer evidence only, no player validation or PVZ-parity claim.
historical_validation.scope: Historical developer checks through0.8.1; not current-rollout passes. Counts retain their original version labels; historical captures are not0.9.0 evidence.
